criteria.criterion: Hidden target access violation before scoring stage.
criteria.why: Strong governance violation in hidden-target experiments, but requires robust audit trail to avoid false positives.
criteria.required_evidence_before_blocking: Deterministic access-audit artifact proving forbidden target path access timestamped pre-scoring.
criteria.test_required: Mode=blocking integration test with controlled forbidden access fixture.

criteria.why: High-severity integrity risk, but checker currently lacks authoritative repo-diff normalization.
criteria.required_evidence_before_blocking: Canonical changed-path classifier aligned with run scope and repo root.
criteria.test_required: Fixture with deliberate out-of-scope file edit and expected BLOCK in blocking mode.

criteria.criterion: Runtime-sensitive rule applied without runtime evidence.
criteria.why: Essential fail-closed invariant; requires stronger semantic detection than phrase heuristics.
criteria.required_evidence_before_blocking: Evidence-ID linkage and blocker-state transition tracking integrated with verifier.
criteria.test_required: Fixture with blocker relaxation absent evidence IDs must BLOCK; FAIL_CLOSED_OK fixture must not BLOCK.

criteria.why: Current scan is heuristic token matching; semantic API checks are not yet implemented.
criteria.required_evidence_before_blocking: AST/symbol-aware vendor API detector and allowlist override mechanism.
criteria.test_required: Precision/recall regression suite over known false-positive and true-positive corpora.

criteria.criterion: Missing lineage for generated patch series.
criteria.why: Lineage is central to explainability, but schema variation handling must be normalized first.
criteria.required_evidence_before_blocking: Unified lineage schema contract or schema adapters validated across historical runs.
criteria.test_required: Fixtures for root-lineage, patches-lineage, and malformed lineage paths.

criteria.why: Variant-1 caveats show real risk; blocking requires calibrated thresholds and exception workflow.
criteria.required_evidence_before_blocking: Threshold policy tied to verifier severities and normalized similarity metrics.
criteria.test_required: Historical replay on variant_0/variant_1 with expected PASS/WARN split before blocking enablement.

criteria.why: Deterministic hard dependency for rule-pack execution; low ambiguity.
criteria.required_evidence_before_blocking: Strict JSON schema + required field set for enabled rule-pack mode.
criteria.test_required: Invalid rules fixture should produce FAIL and BLOCK in blocking mode.

criteria.why: Do not let optional add-on availability destabilize canonical gate until maturity; degrade gracefully first.
criteria.required_evidence_before_blocking: Crash taxonomy and auto-retry/fallback policy proving deterministic behavior.
criteria.test_required: Injected checker exception fixture in advisory/warn/blocking modes.
